sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Emily.
I am happy you are here.
Today we will talk about Georgia.
Georgia is a small, beautiful,
and historic country in the Caucasus region.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Are you ready?
Let's begin.
Where is Georgia?
Georgia is between Europe and Asia.
It is part of the South Caucasus.
It borders Russia, Turkey, Armenia, and Azerbaijan.
To the West, it touches the Black Sea.
Georgia has mountains, forests, valleys, and beaches.
What is the capital city of Georgia?
The capital city is Belisi.
To Belisi is a very old city with hills, rivers,
and colorful buildings.
It has churches, markets, and modern cafes.
Other important cities are
Qutai Sea, one of the oldest cities in the world,
Batumi, a city by the Black Sea,
Rastavi, Gory, and Zugdidi.
How many people live in Georgia?
About 3.7 million people live in Georgia.
Most people live in Belisi or other cities.
Many Georgians also live in other countries.
Georgia is known for its hospitality.
Guests are very welcome.
What language do people speak in Georgia?
People speak Georgian.
It is the official language.
Georgian has its own alphabet, which is unique and very old.
Some people also speak Russian, English, or Armenian.
Young people often learn English in school.
What is the weather like in Georgia?
Georgia has four seasons.
Spring, fresh and green.
Summer, warm or hot with sun.
Autumn, cool and full of fruit.
Winter, cold with snow in the mountains.
The climate is mild near the sea and cooler in the highlands.
What does Georgia look like?
Georgia has the Caucasus Mountains,
the Black Sea coast, forests,
lakes and hot springs,
villages on hills and stone churches,
fertile valleys with vineyards.
It is a country of nature, history and culture.
What animals live in Georgia?
In Georgia, you can see bears, wolves and lynx in the forests,
foxes, deer and wild goats, eagles, falcons and many birds.
Cows, sheep and horses in the countryside.
People also love cats, dogs and farm animals.
What do people eat in Georgia?
Georgian food is rich, warm and full of flavor.
People eat bread, cheese and meat,
vegetables, herbs and nuts.
Popular dishes include kachapuri, cheese filled bread,
kinkali, dumplings with meat or vegetables.
Lobio, beans with spices,
satsadivi, chicken and walnut sauce,
mitzvadi, grilled meat.
Georgians love to share food and have long meals with family and guests.
What do people drink in Georgia?
People drink water, herbal tea,
fruit juice, mineral water from natural springs.
Adults may drink wine.
Georgia is one of the oldest wine countries in the world.
Georgian wine is made in clay pots called kavevery.
What is life like in Georgia?
Life in Georgia is family based and traditional,
but also modern.
People enjoy cooking together,
singing folk songs, going to church,
hiking in nature, talking with friends.
People are proud of their culture and love to welcome visitors.
What are some holidays and traditions in Georgia?
New years celebrated twice,
January, worse and 14,
Orthodox Christmas, January 7,
Easter with red eggs and special food.
Independence Day, May 26,
to Bilosoba, a city festival in October.
During feasts, people say toasts, special words before drinking.
Some fun facts about Georgia.
The Georgian name for Georgia is Succart Velo.
The Georgian alphabet has 33 letters
and looks like a flowing script.
People say,
Gao Marjos, to make a toast.
Polyphonic singing is a special Georgian tradition.
The national flag is white with five red crosses.
Now you know many things about Georgia.
You know where it is, what people speak
and what they eat.
You learned about the cities,
nature, traditions and daily life.
Great job.
I am Emily.
Goodbye.
Or as they say in Georgian,
knock from these.
